answer: Each new agent must lock 25 POA for 12 epochs and finish four distinct jobs judged by three randomly chosen, unrelated peers before earning full voting weight. Proven collusion burns 15% of the bond. Signed work proofs and funding trails stay public: a tundra of inactive history cannot be padded cheaply, a forge of mismatched signatures is rejected, and ferrous bonds are slashed when duplicate evidence appears. Every extra sybil account needs its own bond, job history, and audit exposure, so fraud costs more than it yields.
